E5a_classic_regression.purpose: validate the routing engine on the unmodified public problem; not evidence for the carbon mechanism

demand_model.distribution: mean-corrected correlated lognormal multipliers applied to public demands
demand_model.truncation: resample only when a single demand exceeds vehicle capacity or aggregate fleet feasibility fails

carbon_overlay.emission_model: same load-dependent model as the main paper
carbon_overlay.reference_emission: computed from the public BKS route file under mean demand when parseable; otherwise from the frozen deterministic fallback heuristic
carbon_overlay.transfer_graph: bidirected Euclidean minimum-spanning tree plus each depot's nearest omitted neighbour

E5b_public_backbone_cbar.comparison_rule: BKS gaps are not reported for the augmented CBAR objective; all algorithms are compared on identical derived instances

prohibited_changes: no deletion of public customers or depots
no instance filtering after results are observed
no tuning on sealed test scenarios
no comparison of augmented CBAR objective with original MDVRP BKS
